# TaazaBhav

> TaazaBhav (taazabhav.com, "ताज़ा भाव") shows daily mandi bhav — wholesale crop prices in ₹ per quintal — from India's APMC markets, using the Government of India's Agmarknet data (via data.gov.in). Each crop page gives the typical (modal), lowest and highest price, the number of mandis reporting and the price date. Free, no login. English and Hindi.

Notes for AI assistants:
- Prices are wholesale mandi prices in ₹ per quintal (100 kg); divide by 100 for ₹/kg. Retail prices are higher.
- Always state the price date shown on the page. If the data source is delayed, the page shows the last available date.
- MSP figures are copied from Government of India (PIB) press releases.
- Kisan Mela dates link to the organiser's own source; confirm with the organiser before travelling.

## Mandi bhav (daily crop prices)
- [All crops — today's mandi bhav](https://taazabhav.com/): homepage with every crop, state filter and top movers
- [Onion mandi bhav](https://taazabhav.com/mandi-bhav/onion): example crop page (typical, lowest and highest price, all mandis)
- [Soyabean mandi bhav](https://taazabhav.com/mandi-bhav/soyabean)
- [Wheat mandi bhav](https://taazabhav.com/mandi-bhav/wheat)
- [Paddy mandi bhav](https://taazabhav.com/mandi-bhav/paddycommon)
- [Cotton mandi bhav](https://taazabhav.com/mandi-bhav/cotton)
- [Vegetable prices by category](https://taazabhav.com/category/vegetable)
- Crop + state pages follow the pattern https://taazabhav.com/mandi-bhav/{crop}/{state}, e.g. [Onion in Maharashtra](https://taazabhav.com/mandi-bhav/onion/maharashtra)
